content: Clinical trials investigating dapagliflozin have demonstrated its efficacy in improving kidney and cardiovascular outcomes. Studies conducted under the American Diabetes Association (ADA) have further explored the benefits of dapagliflozin and empagliflozin in patients with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). Specifically, trials such as the DELIVER study evaluated the therapeutic impact of these agents in this patient population. The findings revealed that both dapagliflozin and empagliflozin significantly improved cardiac function and reduced the risk of hospitalizations related to heart failure.
